{{Quote|Despite our best efforts, our witness in the upcoming trial of the suspected gangster Wolga the Hutt has vanished without a trace.|Imperial Judicial Fleet Transmission, concerning Wolga the Hutt|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''Wolga''' was a member of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who was suspected of being a [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]]<ref name="TFUII" /> sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="date">The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was formed during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places in the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Since the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' occur in the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|tie-in comic]], it can be concluded that Wolga the Hutt was alive during that time.</ref> Just prior to the trial of Wolga, the witness, [[Brio Tabbett]], was removed by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wolga the Hutt was first mentioned in the "[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].
